url.description: Direct Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint (HTTP(S) with host, not legacy /sse); mutually exclusive with configPath/server. No embedded credentials or configured auth headers. Private/loopback hosts allowed, redirects disabled. Use a trusted endpoint; configPath+server supports configured headers.

configPath.description: Existing MCP JSON configuration path, absolute or relative to host project cwd. Alone with action=list (default), returns names/transport/enabled flags without starting servers. Add server for discovery or close. Trusted configurations can launch commands or supply HTTP credentials.

server.description: Exact enabled mcpServers key; requires configPath and must be absent with url. Optional only for configuration-only listing; required with configPath for action=close.

action.description: Defaults to list: configPath alone lists configured servers; a full target discovers tools and may start/initialize a connection. close requires configPath+server or url, releases that session-scoped connection and clears its subscriptions/queued updates; later use reconnects. Does not undo remote effects.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-request deadline in seconds, 1-300. Omission uses configured timeout clamped to 1-300 (configuration default 60), or 60 for direct url. Each handshake/discovery request has its own deadline. Ignored for configPath-only listing; close parses it but sends no discovery request.
